programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Lost American Civilization'. Steve explores the Four Corners region, investigating Puebloan sites like Chaco Canyon and Mesa Verde. Shifting the focus from why these societies were abandoned to how they thrived.

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - The Shroud Of Turin'. In the 14th century, a shroud bearing the image of a crucified man surfaced in France before finding a home in Turin. Is this the very shroud that Jesus was wrapped in?

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - The Bones Of John The Baptist'. Who was the real John the Baptist? We explore John as he has been viewed in Christian tradition. We will also see Jesus transformed from a young man to a commanding leader.

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - The Gospel Of Judas'. Why Judas betrayed Jesus is one of the great unanswered Biblical questions. We re-examine Judas as he is portrayed in the Gospels.

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - The Secret Brother Of Jesus'. Discover the remarkable but largely overlooked story of Jesus' brother James. Through his eyes we reveal a new perspective on Jesus' own life, death and Resurrection.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: 'S13/E2 - Worlds Collide: Part 1'. In ALONE's first-ever World Championship, ten new survivalists from across the globe are dropped into the remote and rugged Arctic Circle to battle for $500,000.

programme.title: Repair Shop Australia
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Amanda arrived at The Repair Shop seeking the help of resident horologist Andrew to revive her grandfather's cuckoo clock.

programme.title: Ultimate Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Close Encounters'. Investigating close counters of the mysterious kind. Were Betty & Barney Hill actually abducted, or was it all a fantasy? Does recent evidence now explain where Travis Walton was for 5 days?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S18/E1 - Skulls Of The Gods'. Across the world, archaeologists have found strange, elongated skulls. Did our ancestors modify the shape of their skulls to resemble the visitors- and could some of these be otherworldly?

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S7/E8 - Who Is The Boston Strangler?'. A series of murders shake the city of Boston. Each victim, 13 women, bore the signature of this serial killer: a bow wrapped around their neck. Boston PD is facing huge pressure.

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Darkness Falls'. As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide.
